messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Counterexample: $B_n(x)=x^n$. Pointwise limit discontinuous at one endpoint. Uniform convergence requires continuous limits. Discontinuity proves failure. Thus, pointwise convergence does not guarantee uniform convergence.
